The '''Blast Crew''' was a crime syndicate based on [[Asylum]] and led by [[Tanno Vik]]. Vik and his rival [[Oggo]] of the [[Starbolts]] syndicate disagreed over the control of the [[Free Zone]] black market, settling their dispute with blasters. In [[3631 BBY]] Oggo was unexpectedly killed by [[HK-55]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], allowing Vik to take over the Free Zone, though his reign was short-lived, as Asylum was attacked by the [[Eternal Fleet]] shortly afterwards.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blast Crew appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 6: Asylum'''.
